text:
Gina (Product): Quick heads-up: Streamline Toolcall (v1) is GA on Hosted API. Rolling now, expect full coverage within ~3 hours. Short notes below. :tada:

Theo (Runtime): Congrats. What's different for callers?

Gina (Product): Single endpoint /v1/streamline/toolcall that combines streaming + lightweight tool callbacks. Added route tag support (X-Redwood-Route-Tag) so teams can opt routes into cost/latency personas without changing client code. Backwards compatible.

Marta (SRE): Rollout plan? Canary region and metrics to watch?

Gina (Product): Canary in us-west-1 for 20m, then staged ramp. Watch toolbox.callback_success_rate, stream.first_byte_p95, and route.tag_mismatch_rate. Pager if callback_success_rate < 98% for 10m.

DeployBot: deploy started: hosted-streamline v1.0.0 -> canary(us-west-1) at 1892345800. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/hosted-streamline/1.0.0

Theo (Runtime): Runtime notes: we pre-warm small callback pools and added a soft-fallback to streaming-only when webhook latency > 1.2s. New metric: router.streamline.fallback_rate.

Gina (Product): Example curl (streaming+toolcall):
```
curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streamline/toolcall \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Route-Tag: interactive" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-3b","prompt":"Parse and extract dates","tool_calling":"callbacks","callback_url":"https://hooks.example/receive"}'
```

Marta (SRE): New error codes: 5012 = streamline.backpressure, 5013 = streamline.callback_timeout. Adding runbook: if 5012 spike, reduce concurrency or route to legacy endpoint. Setting alert: streamline.callback_timeout > 1% for 10m -> page.

Anya (Docs): I'll update the quickstart and SDK examples. Small migration note: teams on older toolcall endpoints continue to work; recommend moving when ready to get lower tail latency. ETA 90m.

DeployBot: canary completed: hosted-streamline v1.0.0 -> us-west-1 OK (1892346100). Next region: eu-west-1 at +25m.

Theo (Runtime): Minor ops note: increase in small TCP connections observed in canary; we tuned connection pooling. No customer action required.

Gina (Product): Thanks team 1 — please react with :thumbsup: when tasks are done. We'll monitor metrics and post any anomalies to #incidents.

Marta (SRE): :thumbsup:

Anya (Docs): :thumbsup:

Theo (Runtime): :thumbsup:

Gina (Product): Rollout complete across regions at 1892346780. If you see customer-impacting issues, ping @oncall or me immediately.
